definitions.groups: Counts refer to 17 non-published research candidate records: A eligible additions, B technically promising pending review, C failed/insecure/insufficient; existing AIR endpoint is a separate control.
definitions.identity: Official-player association is documentary evidence, not human identification of the emitted programme.
definitions.unavailable: Observed failed endpoints, not permanent closure of broadcasters.
definitions.decoding: Browser HTMLAudio playback progress is separate from FFmpeg decoding and human audibility.

sources.observation: Existing named Akashvani service mappings retained from Stage 6; Nagercoil manifest/segment rechecked in Stage 9; no endpoint or use approval change.
Stage 8 preserved all archived records and documented Thoothukudi 404. Historical evidence retained; this is not a fresh Stage 9 test of every archived feed.
Names ten established city services; web stories and podcasts do not establish continuous Internet simulcasts.
Confirms Suryan/RED relationship and localized FM content; no direct city audio mapping established.
Article explicitly dated 18 August 2026 reports Nagercoil 91.9 MHz, eleventh Suryan station. It is not a Prasar Bharati/AIR source.
SuryanFM-branded public post announces Nagercoil 91.9; relative displayed dates do not independently establish the exact launch day or verify account control.
Dated terrestrial permission-holder/frequency list. Predates August; cannot disprove newer Nagercoil launch. Erode/Salem/Vellore RED labels need reconciliation with current Suryan branding.
Lists Nagercoil Hello 91.1 and Suryan 91.9, and Karur Suryan 94.7. These are frequency leads, not Internet audio or current regulator/broadcaster confirmation.
Publishes the supplied tamil.crabdance.com:8002/2 HTTPS URL; no independent city or authorization proof.
HTTPS connection refused in safe transport. Current Nagercoil 91.1 operations not authoritatively re-established here.
Redirects to stories; bounded homepage includes a streaming SDK but no proven Tamil city stream. SDK presence is not an endpoint.
Describes stories, music playlists and live streams separately; references Indian stations for listeners outside India. No geography or account controls bypassed.
Retrieved podcast MP3 references are finite programmes, not live FM streams.
Document itself is dated 2 July 2015 and names Radio City Tamil among web-radio services. Recent crawl date is not publication date; no current live endpoint established.
Homepage provides programme/interview MP3 files, not proof of a Tamil FM continuous stream.
Site reachable; no distinct Tamil local stream established. Kerala service must remain Kerala/Malayalam unless independently evidenced otherwise.
Owner identifies English talk/music service and digital transition; contradicts generic directory Tamil/community labels.
Chennai Live video dated 24 November 2020 describes transition to digital; not evidence of a currently operating FM transmitter.
Identifies Tamil/Malayalam Internet radio from Parakunnu near Kuzhithurai; current page links annai-fm.mdn.live. Player startup ended with media error 4.
Reachable Annai-branded provider landing page. Canonical reusable direct URL not established in bounded HTML.
Corroborates Parakunnu/Kuzhithurai; public radio-streams-json is encrypted. No decryption or authenticated metadata requests attempted.
Current bounded player HTML lists HTTP Zeno mounts; old officially published HTTPS cast endpoint still 404. No guessed scheme upgrades.
Broadcaster about page reached; keep Monday Market/Neyyoor origin review distinct from directory Nagercoil city grouping.
Lists Monday Market, Neyyoor postal area, Kanyakumari; encrypted stream configuration not decrypted.
ENOTFOUND again. Service migration not established; do not invent a new domain.
Still links old broadcaster domain; encrypted stream configuration not decrypted.

Official Vaani Seva player uses https://iskconnagercoil.com/webdio. Two in-app-browser HTML-audio startups advanced to 3.415027s and 2.404790s without media errors. Footer locates institution at Puliyurkurichi, Kanyakumari; exact transmitter terminology is inapplicable.
Advertises online radio; broadcaster association independently corroborates directory lead. Content schedule is multi-language/unspecified; Tamil-only claim not inferred from a directory.
Directory labels Tamil and Nagercoil; native request timed out. Language/origin details require official evidence, not directory assertion alone.
Lists Internet players for many networks; availability to local listeners is not origin. Includes insecure crabdance and unknown HTTPS alternative.
Popular/live/AIR categories and supplied Hello/Mirchi pages reviewed before discovering explicit automation prohibition. Stopped further automated access; no stream URLs copied from this portal.
Prohibits automated bots/scrapers/crawlers without written consent. Also prohibits unpermitted audio recording/redistribution. Further automated inspection stopped.
Personal noncommercial access license; ownership/use/deep-linking restrictions. No third-party RadioBee direct-play allowance established; do not treat as blanket permission.
Terms page version dated 27 October 2026 reviewed. Provider hosting/public listening does not establish broadcaster rights for RadioBee embedding, recording or redistribution.
Page retrieved; no explicit RadioBee third-party playback, recording or redistribution grant established.
Ten bounded name queries plus four country-filtered queries, at most 12/20 rows each. Limits and inconsistent country labels prevent claims of exhaustive coverage.
Cross-checks regional listings; Chennai Live source is HTTP and directory wraps it with an unrelated proxy. Proxy not used or republished.
Existing separately named Tamil Internet service; retains global/unspecified origin. Prior-stage provenance retained, not a new Stage 9 city-origin verification.
Search-indexed launch post claims Tamil/English online channels; posting in Kanyakumari subreddit does not prove origin. Full page unavailable; no direct URL or station added.
